heroTitle: Rope as connection, trust, and desire.
intro: A warm, consent-centered space for learning rope as connection, presence, and embodied communication.
invitationTitle: A place for curiosity to move slowly.
invitationText: Love & Rope Studio offers grounded shibari instruction for people who want to learn with tenderness, attention, and practical safety skills.
Sessions may be sensual, artistic, meditative, or technical. They are always built around consent, boundaries, and clear communication.

cards.title: Group Classes
cards.description: Beginner-friendly rope foundations, partner communication, and decorative floor-based ties.

cards.title: Private Sessions
cards.description: Personalized lessons for individuals, couples, and small groups who want a quieter learning container.

cards.title: Consent First
cards.description: Every class includes negotiation, body awareness, risk education, and aftercare-minded communication.
